author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 11 volume 1 (chapters 1-4) follows the 2023 science textbook: every lesson's points, point quizzes, worksheets and bank match the textbook sections; lesson titles carry textbook lesson numbers and pages; new advanced lesson on inverse trigonometric functions; chapter exams for the basic course are now chapter-level; advanced lesson exams keep only problems from their lesson.
